# SpinDraw

> SpinDraw (https://spindraw.online) is a free random name picker and raffle tool. A locked, cryptographically fair draw picks every winner (HMAC-SHA256 of a committed 256-bit seed), and the chosen game only reveals it, so every entry has exactly its share of the chance in every game. Anyone can re-check a draw with its verify link. No sign-up; names are stored only in the browser unless the host shares a verify link or proof file.

## Games (each page is the working tool)
- [Random name picker wheel](https://spindraw.online/random-name-picker/): A random name picker wheel is a spinning wheel with one slice per name. You paste your list, spin, and the pointer lands on a random winner. SpinDraw’s wheel is free, needs no sign-up, handles thousands of names, lets you give someone extra entries with “Name x3”, and can give you a link that proves the pick was fair.
- [Marble race name picker](https://spindraw.online/ball-race-name-picker/): A marble race name picker turns a list of names into a race: each name gets a marble, the marbles roll down an obstacle course, and the first to finish wins. SpinDraw’s marble race is free, takes up to 100 names, can rank up to 50 finishers in order, and uses a locked fair draw, so every entry has exactly its share of the chance.
- [Horse race name picker](https://spindraw.online/horse-race-name-picker/): A horse race name picker turns your list into a virtual horse race: each name gets a horse, they race to the finish, and the first across the line wins. SpinDraw’s horse race is free, takes up to 100 names, can rank up to 50 finishers in order for a draft order or prize list, and uses a locked fair draw so every entry has exactly its share of the chance.
- [Battle royale name picker](https://spindraw.online/battle-royale-name-picker/): A battle royale name picker turns each name into a fighter in one arena, and the last fighter standing wins. SpinDraw’s pixel battle is free, takes up to 100 names, can pick up to 50 winners from the last ones standing, and uses a locked fair draw, so a fighter’s looks or stats never change anyone’s chances.
- [Slot machine name picker](https://spindraw.online/slot-machine-name-picker/): A slot machine name picker, sometimes called a fruit machine name picker, puts your names on a spinning reel and stops on a random winner when you pull the lever. SpinDraw’s slot machine is free, works with lists of any size, picks up to 50 winners with one pull each, and uses a locked fair draw with a verify link anyone can check.
- [Random bracket generator](https://spindraw.online/random-bracket-generator/): A random bracket generator puts a list of names into a single-elimination tournament with random matchups. SpinDraw’s bracket is free, takes 2 to 64 names, hands out byes automatically, and plays every match out on screen to pick a champion, a runner-up and a third-place match. A locked fair draw picks the winners, so bracket position never changes anyone’s odds.
- [Online bingo](https://spindraw.online/online-bingo/): SpinDraw online bingo is a free bingo caller with cards. The host shows the caller on a big screen or a video call, players open their own card on their phone from a link or QR code (or use printed cards), and the host checks a winning card by its number. It supports 75-ball and 90-ball bingo, and the call order comes from a locked fair draw anyone can verify afterwards.

## Guides
- [Office raffle](https://spindraw.online/office-raffle/): Run your holiday party raffle, door prizes or team giveaway on the big screen or in a video call. Free, no sign-up, with proof the draw was fair.
- [Secret Santa & gift exchange](https://spindraw.online/secret-santa-name-picker/): Draw names for Secret Santa, Kris Kringle, Wichteln or Amigo Secreto. A random gift chain where nobody gets themselves. Free and fair, no sign-up.
- [Classroom name picker](https://spindraw.online/classroom-name-picker/): A free random name picker for teachers: spin on the projector or in an online class, give every student a turn, and keep class lists on your computer.
- [Facebook Live raffle](https://spindraw.online/facebook-live-raffle/): Run a Facebook Live raffle from your comments: paste them in, filter by keyword, remove duplicates and spin a free raffle wheel on stream. No Facebook login.
- [TikTok LIVE giveaway](https://spindraw.online/tiktok-live-giveaway-wheel/): A free giveaway wheel made for TikTok LIVE: vertical 9:16 overlay, comment and Google Form entries, claim timer and a proof link your viewers can check.
- [OBS spin wheel overlay](https://spindraw.online/obs-spin-wheel/): Add a free spin-the-wheel overlay to OBS or Streamlabs as a browser source. Transparent background, 16:9 or 9:16, synced to a control panel. No sign-up.
- [YouTube Live giveaway](https://spindraw.online/youtube-live-giveaway/): Pick a random winner from YouTube Live chat or comments. Paste chat lines, count one entry per viewer, give members extra entries and spin on stream.
- [Name picker alternatives compared](https://spindraw.online/random-name-picker-alternatives/): Wheel of Names, Picker Wheel, Roulette Rush, Namebrawl, Uplup and more compared: price, limits, games, fair odds, and which one suits your draw.
- [Picker Wheel alternative](https://spindraw.online/picker-wheel-alternative/): Comparing Picker Wheel and SpinDraw: wheel modes, ads, saved files, name race games and verifiable draws, plus when you should stay with Picker Wheel.
- [Wheel of Names alternative](https://spindraw.online/wheel-of-names-alternative/): A Wheel of Names alternative for raffles people trust: verifiable draws, paste names or comments, several prizes, claim timers and a stream overlay. Free.
